message: this spells the milliseconds to nanoseconds conversion out in integers
fix: build a `Duration` and let the unit live in the type rather than in the name
notes: `core/time`'s `Duration` is the length itself — `time.millis(n)`, `time.seconds(n)` — and its arithmetic saturates, so a deadline built from one cannot overflow into the past
